title: Drummer and the Whale
sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories
description: Deterministic persistent state graph for the underwater signal hunt, Militech submarine crisis, player-owned cargo decision, multiple climaxes and endings.
premise: Drummer and Fife hire the Crew to trace a strange pre-war signal trail that leads from the Night City waterfront beneath Morro Bay and into a dangerous military secret.
publicBackground: Drummer has identified a pattern of unusual signals and missing cargo containers and wants proof of their origin.
gmBackground: The trail ultimately intersects a Militech military submarine operation. The engine must not reveal military ownership early, must not force the Crew to keep or surrender the cargo, and must preserve the distinct Takeover, Parley, Fishy Flight and Surfacing climax routes.

startDefinition.openingSituation: The Crew meets Drummer and Fife at Rusty's waterfront dive bar and hears the job.

locations.name: Rusty's Dive Bar
locations.descriptionPublic: A rough waterfront dive bar and diving shop.
locations.descriptionGM: Drummer gives the container-search job here; Fife provides technical support.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

locations.name: South Night City Waterfront
locations.descriptionPublic: Storm-battered seawall and beach littered with wreckage and cargo.
locations.descriptionGM: The new logo-free carbon-resin capsule is the target. Search and salvage checks belong to Rules Engine.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

locations.name: Fife's Submarine
locations.descriptionPublic: Fife's small civilian submarine, equipped to support a dive team and ROV work.
locations.descriptionGM: The Crew receives dive gear and uses the ROV to trace the signal through submerged NCART tunnels.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

locations.name: Flooded NCART Tunnels
locations.descriptionPublic: Collapsed transit tunnels beneath Morro Bay, clogged by debris and microfiber tangles.
locations.descriptionGM: ROV navigation and obstruction clearing are mechanical checks. The route eventually exposes the military operation.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

locations.name: SS MacDonnelson
locations.descriptionPublic: A large submarine encountered beneath the bay once the Crew penetrates the hidden operation.
locations.descriptionGM: Militech/U.S. military ownership and scuttling capability are protected facts until discovered. Boarding does not imply takeover.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

npcs.name: Drummer
npcs.motivation: Understand the source of the signal pattern.
npcs.publicKnowledge: Has identified a pattern involving unusual cargo movement and signals.
npcs.dialogueGuidance: He wants information about origin more than the container's contents.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

npcs.name: Fife
npcs.personality: Loyal, technically capable and protective of Drummer.
npcs.motivation: Help Drummer prove the discovery and get everyone home alive.
npcs.publicKnowledge: Owns and operates the support submarine.
npcs.dialogueGuidance: Once lives are at stake, survival matters more than the discovery; do not make Fife suicidal.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

npcs.name: Commander Walsh
npcs.motivation: Protect the vessel, cargo and military secrecy.
npcs.secretKnowledge: Can order or activate the submarine's Scuttling Program.
npcs.dialogueGuidance: Negotiation is possible in appropriate branches; if the Crew attempts takeover, the ship's crew resists fiercely.

Do not force combat if the Crew finds another valid route.

resolutionRules: Only enter this encounter after failed/refused parley or player-selected violence.

resolutionRules: This climax exists only if the Crew chooses to seize the vessel.
